channel.title: Boulder Daily Camera - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Boulder Daily Camera (dailycamera.com)

item.title: Silver Creek boys basketball punches its ticket to 5A final four
item.description: To reach the peak of Class 5A boys basketball, a team needs the type of discipline, drive and heart to set it apart from the rest of the pack. Silver Creek head coach Bob Banning compared the challenge to mountaineering's greatest beast.

item.title: Elijah Malone trying to finish strong in final bow with CU Buffs
item.description: It was about a year ago, not long after Elijah Malone received an unexpected extra year of eligibility, when Tad Boyle said he’d be happy to bring the 6-foot-10 center for another season.

item.title: Deion Sanders hopes Brennan Marion brings explosiveness back to CU Buffs offense
item.description: During the process of interviewing candidates for the offensive coordinator job this past offseason, Colorado head coach Deion Sanders had one main priority in mind.

item.title: Sizing up Avalanche and Western Conference contenders after NHL trade deadline | Journal
item.description: Shorty after the 2026 NHL trade deadline passed, the general managers for the teams currently in third and fourth place in the league standings offered a very similar summation of what just transpired.

item.title: Sundance officials expect hundreds of millions in economic impact when the festival moves to Boulder
item.description: In 2025, the Sundance Film Festival generated an economic impact of $196.1 million and attracted 85,472 in-person attendees — numbers that Sundance officials expect to maintain or even grow as the festival moves to Boulder.

item.title: Boulder City Council talks affordable housing funding
item.description: Data presented to the Boulder City Council illustrates the state of affordable housing in Boulder.

item.title: Holy Family girls, Peak to Peak boys advance in 4A playoffs
item.description: Both the Holy Family girls and Peak to Peak boys will next play on Wednesday in the Great 8, hosted at the Denver Coliseum.

item.title: Colorado women’s basketball falls short in Big 12 semifinals
item.description: KANSAS CITY, Mo. – Colorado had a potential trip to the Big 12 championship game stolen. Literally.

item.title: Despite loss, CU Buffs defense locked down West Virginia
item.description: KANSAS CITY, Mo. – Offensively, the Colorado women’s basketball team struggled throughout its loss to West Virginia on Saturday night. Defensively, however, the Buffaloes brought their A game, despite the 48-47 loss in the Big 12 semifinals at T-Mobile Center.

item.title: No. 2 Arizona escapes Colorado’s upset bid
item.description: For the most part, Colorado has dominated the teams behind it in the Big 12 Conference standings. At the same time, the Buffaloes have struggled against the teams ahead of them.
